sub_categories.name: App & Device Automation
sub_categories.description: Automating desktop apps, OS-level control, and mobile devices — tapping/typing/scrolling, screenshots, and controlling creative/office software.

skills.name: agent-device
skills.description: Automates Apple-platform apps (iOS, tvOS, macOS) and Android devices. Use when navigating apps, taking snapshots/screenshots, tapping, typing, scrolling, extracting UI info, collecting logs/network/perf evidence, or planning agent-device CLI commands.

skills.name: screenshot
skills.description: Use when the user explicitly asks for a desktop or system screenshot (full screen, specific app or window, or a pixel region), or when tool-specific capture capabilities are unavailable and an OS-level capture is needed.

skills.name: Desktop Control
skills.description: Control mouse, keyboard, and screen for desktop automation tasks

skills.name: flue
skills.description: Let agents control software, including Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere, Autodesk 3DS Max, Blender, Unity, Houdini, and Microsoft Office.

skills.name: tmux
skills.description: Control tmux sessions/panes for interactive CLIs: list, capture output, send keys, paste text, monitor prompts.

skills.name: findmy
skills.description: Track Apple devices/AirTags via FindMy.app on macOS.

sub_categories.name: Other
sub_categories.description: Automation skills that do not fit the above subcategories.
